description: This file defines an LLMTextProcessor class that processes frames containing LLM output text, converting them into aggregated text frames using a configurable text aggregator. It handles various frame types such as LLMTextFrame, InterruptionFrame, end frames, and manages the aggregation, resetting, and frame processing logic within a pipeline.

classes.name: LLMTextProcessor
classes.description: A frame processor class that handles and manipulates LLM text frames, converting them into aggregated frames based on a configurable text aggregator.

methods.name: __init__(self, *, text_aggregator: Optional[BaseTextAggregator] = None, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the LLMTextProcessor with an optional text aggregator, defaulting to SimpleTextAggregator if none provided.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, handling different frame types (interruption, LLMTextFrame, end frames) and managing aggregation accordingly.

methods.name: _handle_interruption(self, _)
methods.description: Handles interruption frames by resetting the text aggregator.

methods.name: reset(self)
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the text processor and its aggregator.

methods.name: _handle_llm_text(self, in_frame: LLMTextFrame)
methods.description: Handles LLMTextFrame by aggregating its text content and producing aggregated frames.

methods.name: _handle_llm_end(self, skip_tts: Optional[bool] = None)
methods.description: Handles end frames, flushing remaining aggregation data and optionally setting skip_tts.
